newsitem.title: UK: UK wool trade worried by strong sterling.
newsitem.headline: UK wool trade worried by strong sterling.

text.p: Holidays made for a featureless UK wool market amid anxieties about export prospects because of the strength of the pound sterling and the loss of business to competitors on the Continent.
The industry mourned Maurice Grass, a leading figure for many years in UK textiles who died last week.

Grass moved from the Illingworth,Morris group to take charge at the British Wool Marketing Board and saw it through before he retired from government-subsidized support to an independent marketing role.
